title: Lottie
summary: Small vector accents in the theme look: flat ink drawings in bone and silver on the navy field with crimson as the only colour. Lines draw on, stamps press, hands sweep. Generated from code in lottie/generate.mjs.

items.name: Hourglass
items.description: Crimson sand runs through, then the glass turns over. Loops.

items.name: Clock sweep
items.description: Clock hands sweep three hours forward and settle: time passing.

items.name: Date flip
items.description: Two leaves of a wall calendar flip away to the marked day.

items.name: Candle
items.description: A candle flame wavering in a cold glow. Loops.

items.name: Quill line
items.description: A quill crosses the frame and leaves a crimson ink line behind it.

items.name: Scroll open
items.description: A scroll unrolls from the middle, its lines write on and a seal lands.

items.name: Stamp press
items.description: A rubber stamp comes down on a sheet, leaves its crimson mark and lifts away.

items.name: Wax seal
items.description: A crimson wax seal is pressed on over two ribbons and its emblem appears.

items.name: Film reel
items.description: A film reel turning over a strip of leader. Loops.

items.name: Route pin
items.description: A dashed route travels across a made-up island and a pin settles at its end.

items.name: Compass settle
items.description: A compass needle swings and settles on north.

items.name: Laurel
items.description: A laurel wreath draws on leaf by leaf around a crimson mark: an honour, a victory, a founding.
